translations.web: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.
translations.bsb: Take millstones and grind flour; remove your veil; strip off your skirt, bare your thigh, and wade through the streams.
translations.kjv: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
translations.asv: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove thy veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.
